title: ICC-ES ESR-5363: Arboreal cross-laminated timber (CLT)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
code_edition: 2024 and 2021 IBC and IRC; ANSI/APA PRG 320-2019 (report §1.1, p1)
document_date: Reissued April 2026; subject to renewal April 2027 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder ARBOREAL SA; subject is cross-laminated timber.
Components in floors, roofs and walls in construction types permitted by the 2024 or 2021 IBC; under the IRC an engineered design is required per §R301.1.3.
Connections must be designed by a registered design professional per the NDS or ICC-ES-recognized connectors.
In-plane forces on panels are outside the scope of the evaluation; cutting, drilling and notching are also outside.
Beams or lintels loaded parallel to face-bond glue lines are outside scope; special inspection per applicable IBC Sections 1704 and 1705.
Evidence listed: ICC-ES AC455, approved October 2022, editorially revised June 2024.
